title: 百亿补贴不撒消费者：拼多多先喂商家合规，平台重心转向哪
speaker: Catherine Lim

segments.en: Right you know that's the number that I think you know most people actually forgot that PDD's the bulk of their earnings is actually still coming from China.
segments.zh: 没错，大家可能忽略了，拼多多的大部分收入其实还是来自内地市场。

segments.en: And if you look at that number itself and that the one to take off is the online marketing services.
segments.zh: 看这个数字，最值得注意的是在线营销服务。

segments.en: It's actually trilling the entire online retail sales growth that we've really seen.
segments.zh: 它实际上拉动了整体线上零售的增长。

segments.en: And the reality is that you know consumption isn't great merchants unspending and more importantly PDD's actually subsidizing.
segments.zh: 现实是消费不算强劲，商家支出减少，更重要的是拼多多在提供补贴。

segments.en: You know some of your merchants you know they have a 10 billion program that's out there that they are literally getting I guess their merchants to be more compliant you know with their product qualities etc.
segments.zh: 他们有一个百亿补贴项目，实际上是让商家更注重商品质量等合规要求。

segments.en: So I think the focus for PDD isn't really trying to monetize you know their platform to their merchants but you know more importantly trying to actually help some of these Chinese merchants itself get to speak on compliance etc.
segments.zh: 所以拼多多的重点不是向商家变现，而是帮助内地商家提升合规水平。

segments.en: So they're not in a rush to actually you know try to get more out of them.
segments.zh: 所以他们并不急于从商家身上获取更多。
